title: 1 in 4 people in Japan believes AI could replace friends and family: poll
excerpt: In the survey, 30.8% of the overall respondents said they use generative AI, such as ChatGPT, while 67.8% said they do not.
content_html:
One in four people in Japan believes that more advanced artificial intelligence will replace their friends and families in the future, a Jiji survey on communications has found.

The proportion of those who expressed this belief stood at 24.9%, while 65.1% said they did not think AI would replace their friends and families.

Of the respondents aged between 18 and 29, 32.5% said that advanced AI would replace their friends and families in the future. The proportion stood at 30.1% among respondents in their 30s, 29.2% among those in their 40s and 31.4% among those in their 50s.

In the survey, 30.8% of the overall respondents said they use generative AI, such as ChatGPT, while 67.8% said they do not.

The usage rate came to 53.3% among those aged between 18 and 29, 56.2% among those in their 30s, 47.4% among those in their 40s, 27.4% among those in their 50s and 21.9% among those in their 60s.

Asked what they use generative AI for, with multiple answers allowed, 64.7%, the largest group, said they use it for work, followed by 35.3% who cited cleaning, cooking and other household chores and 27.1% who said they use it to ask questions about current affairs. Also, 21.7% said they chat with AI about their favorite music, characters and celebrities, and 12.8% said that they use AI to express worries and complaints about love and work.

The interview-based survey was conducted on 2,000 people age 18 or older nationwide for four days from June 12. Valid responses were given by 57.1%.

content_html_zh:
Jiji 的一项通信调查发现，四分之一的日本人认为未来更先进的人工智能将取代他们的朋友和家人。

表示这一信念的比例为24.9%，而65.1%的人表示他们不认为人工智能会取代他们的朋友和家人。

在18岁至29岁的受访者中，32.5%的人表示，先进的人工智能未来将取代他们的朋友和家人。 30多岁的受访者比例为30.1%，40多岁的受访者比例为29.2%，50多岁的受访者比例为31.4%。

在调查中，30.8%的受访者表示他们使用生成式人工智能，例如ChatGPT，而67.8%的人表示他们没有使用。

18-29岁人群的使用率为53.3%，30多岁人群为56.2%，40多岁人群为47.4%，50多岁人群为27.4%，60多岁人群为21.9%。

当被问及他们使用生成式人工智能做什么时（可以有多个答案），最大的群体 64.7% 的人表示他们将其用于工作，其次是 35.3% 的人，他们提到了清洁、烹饪和其他家务，还有 27.1% 的人表示他们用它来询问有关时事的问题。 此外，21.7%的人表示他们与AI聊天喜欢的音乐、人物和名人，12.8%的人表示他们使用AI表达对爱情和工作的担忧和抱怨。

这项基于访谈的调查从6月12日开始为期四天，对全国2000名18岁以上的人进行了调查。 57.1%的人给出了有效答复。
